study.question: Observed limitation: the combined model reaches validation click AUC0.6670575100016033 versus frozen sources0.660646940486458 and0.660163362657485, but auxiliary mean quality is not uniformly preserved. Restricting adapter transfer by task, history population, context fields or tangent direction has not improved click AUC. Round36 tangent=0.6669068957035179, matched attenuation=0.6668688300547352, full=0.6670575100016033, blocked=0.6668051956575413. Does the omitted radial component alone preserve useful transfer, or are radial and tangent components jointly necessary for this implementation?
study.hypothesis: The full auxiliary adapter context cotangent contains useful complementary radial and tangent components relative to each context field embedding. Full transfer should exceed either component alone; radial-only is a feasible candidate that could instead reveal tangent interference. The missing radial-only cell discriminates these explanations. Existing same-seed results provide local observations, not repeated mechanism support, and the0.00003807 tangent-versus-attenuation gap does not establish a directional mechanism.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit the identity-forward shared auxiliary context custom VJP. Replace tangent-only with its complementary radial-only VJP and compare against full direction attenuated to radial norm. Complete missing mechanism contrast; no new architecture or priority claim.

inherited_components: Entire incumbent forward model from g0-r0031-adapter_context_only: shared embeddings, action-aware local scorer, uf compression, five detail channels, task-specific zero-output-initialized adapters, four Dice towers, support folding and pruned eval.

study.proposed_difference: For context field e and aggregate auxiliary adapter cotangent g, u=e/||e|| when ||e||^2>1e-12, otherwise u=0; r=u(g dot u), t=g-r. For ||g||^2<=1e-30 use r=0,t=g. Radial candidate returns r; radial_norm_matched control returns g*sqrt(||r||^2/max(||g||^2,1e-30)), with zero for the same negligible-gradient guard. Tangent bridge returns t; full bridge bypasses custom VJP and returns g. Project exactly once after summing the three auxiliary adapter contributions, before accumulation with unchanged click gradients. All partial modes execute the same FP32 calculations; only the selected returned cotangent differs. Eval bypasses this node. Zero reference sends radial and matched gradients to zero and tangent to g, preserving t+r=g rather than silently treating a zero vector as radial. No added learned parameters, losses, optimizer state or data inputs.
predictions: Predeclared primary comparison: full click AUC exceeds radial-only and tangent-only if both components are useful. Radial-only exceeding full contradicts the complementarity hypothesis and instead supports a candidate tangent-interference explanation requiring replication.

Directional attribution requires radial-only to exceed its locally equal-norm full-direction control; a gain shared by both is consistent with attenuation rather than radial geometry. No single-seed significance claim.

Using blocked g0-r0036-context_blocked_bridge (0.6668051956575413), compute descriptive interaction A_full-A_radial-A_tangent+A_blocked. Positive interaction alone is insufficient: require full above both components, successful source checks, and eventual independent paired-seed support. AUC interaction is path-dependent, not a structural causal additive law.

Fixed-state probabilities, learned state and Dice buffers should match across cells before updates; tangent/full bridges should reproduce their round36 validation values under the same host execution. Total/embedding/dense parameters should remain32129765/31793216/336549. Projection runs only in training; eval cost should remain within measured variability.

Report all task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, history slices with counts from authorized scorer, wall/GPU cost, peak memory and throughput/latency. Slices are exploratory; no new unobserved slice counts are invented.
falsifiers: Radial-only is no better than blocked transfer, or full is no better than one component: useful joint complementarity is unsupported for this implementation.
Radial-only is indistinguishable from its norm-matched control in a future paired uncertainty analysis: no directional attribution; equal or worse point estimates are grounds to stop this branch.

Bridge failures, different initial learned state, changed forward probabilities/buffers, gradients leaking to blocked sources, masks violated, nonfinite VJPs or incomplete full validation invalidate comparison and require host diagnosis before interpreting scores.
Added measured runtime or memory erases any predictive benefit on the quality-cost frontier; parameter parity alone is insufficient.

No three paired seeds or user-cluster uncertainty are available in the frozen seed contract. Retain all conclusions as preliminary; do not reinterpret repeated deterministic bridges as independent support.
alternative_explanations: Per-example/per-field VJP geometry does not imply geometry of the accumulated sparse gradient or Adagrad parameter update; repeated field IDs and shared tables aggregate gradients.
Training trajectories and Dice moments can diverge after the first update; global dense gradient clipping still couples task losses. Forward parity is a fixed-state claim.

Only the frozen seed is admissible in this proposal. Same-seed bridges are reproducibility checks, not independent repetitions. Many prior validation choices induce selection bias; no significance or production claim.

The original context embedding is not proved scale-invariant. Radial means projection relative to the current embedding vector, with signed coefficient; it is not necessarily a norm-increasing update.

Older failures show architectural changes do not automatically help: round6 compressed_task underperformed both imported source bests; round9 match-detail exceeded its count control; round27 folding and unweighted changes mixed execution and normalization effects. These are distinct trajectories, not repeated evidence for radial transfer.

Tangent versus radial removes different amounts of per-field signal; local norm matching only controls that amount at the comparison state, not downstream state drift, frequency weighting or aggregate optimizer step. Padding/OOV frequencies may influence which field embeddings receive transfer.

Round32 unblocking item routes reduced click AUC; round33 task restrictions, round34 history gates and round35 context field restrictions all failed to exceed the incumbent. These restrict plausible explanations but neither refute the broader task nor demonstrate synergy. There is no recorded execution failure in the supplied recent history; null scientific outcomes and unavailable local tensor execution are different conditions.
